reading.body:
Digital Realty operates a multi-building data center campus in the New York/New Jersey region, with EWR11 located in Piscataway Township as one of at least three confirmed facilities in the metro area.

The facility's capacity in megawatts remains unconfirmed from tier-1 sources. Digital Realty's own site confirms the address and general location but does not publish per-building power consumption. This gap matters because power consumption is the direct constraint on AI workload placement. A data center's existence does not tell you whether it can support incremental AI compute demand or whether it is already saturated.

The Piscataway location sits within New Jersey's EWR metro cluster, part of the larger Northeast corridor infrastructure. Geographic clustering of multiple facilities under one operator can indicate shared power infrastructure or grid interconnection, though the data does not confirm whether EWR11, EWR12, and EWR21 draw from a common utility connection or independent feeds.

Researchers tracking AI infrastructure capacity should note that operator websites remain incomplete for power planning. Capacity data requires utility filings, real estate databases, or direct operator disclosure. The research status marked as "complete" reflects address confirmation only, not the power constraint that actually determines the facility's role in AI scaling.
